entries.EN: %c[255,160,160,160]Hidden:\n%c[default]I'm standing over a dead loner. I have no idea how to describe this, but his head... Damn, it looks like a dry raisin. Just a dark-gray, wrinkled fruit with holes, those were the eyes most probably. Wait... There are some punctures on his forehead, just as if someone punched a tube through his skull and literally drank him... I'm getting out of here! This is too much, I'm done... Think I'm gonna hurl..

entries.EN: %c[255,160,160,160]Hidden:\n%c[default]Yesterday night I woke up around three, felt a chill on my back... Noticed something in the room with me, it was lurking in a pitch dark corner of the room, just watching... Now, I'm not a religious man, but that night.. I prayed for the first time in 20 years! I couldn't move a muscle, meat on a platter for whatever that was. Then all of a sudden, it just vanished.. I don't understand anything, was it a dream?? I need a cig.. Anyone selling?

entries.JA_new: %c[255,160,160,160]非公開：\n%c[default]昨日の夜、3時ごろに目が覚めた。背筋が凍るような気がして、部屋の中に何かいると気づいた。真っ暗な隅で、そいつがじっとこっちを見てた……俺は信心深くないが、その夜は20年ぶりに祈った！体が動かず、そいつに食われるのを待つしかなかった。次の瞬間、そいつは消えてた……何だったんだ？夢なのか？タバコが欲しい……誰か売ってくれないか？
